title: A newer run of the same jobs clears an old scheduled red
why: Incident, Nov 2 00:01 CST: the merge tool refused joyous #68 because an Oct 26 scheduled link-check run on an old main was red, though a newer run on today's main passed. Since PR #1013 the tool judges scheduled runs as their own group, so a stale scheduled red blocks until the next scheduled run.
note:
Nov 6 11:51 CST (coordinator audit, Explore sonnet; PR head reachable from origin/main): DONE, evidence #1067 on main.
Lane [ended:lane-red-main-stale-schedule], started Nov 2 00:04 CST. Page item 161 waits on it or on the owner's override. Ready. Port: yes. Owner, Queue item 161 b, Nov 2 00:56 CST: no override for joyous #68; it merges after this fix.
